title: card.usage.test Response Application Programming Interface (API) Schema
description: Returns the results of a data usage test simulation, providing estimates for device lifetime based on historical data patterns.

max.description: The maximum projected days of data availability based on the test results and specified quota.

days.description: The number of days used in the test analysis period.

bytes_per_day.description: Average bytes per day consumed during the analyzed test period.

seconds.description: Total number of seconds in the analyzed test period.

time.description: Start time (Unix epoch seconds) of the analyzed period.

bytes_sent.description: Number of bytes sent by the Notecard to Notehub during the test period.

bytes_received.description: Number of bytes received by the Notecard from Notehub during the test period.

notes_sent.description: Approximate number of Notes sent by the Notecard to Notehub during the test period.

notes_received.description: Approximate number of Notes received by the Notecard from Notehub during the test period.

sessions_standard.description: Number of standard Notehub sessions during the test period.

sessions_secure.description: Number of secure Notehub sessions during the test period.
